mod.name: Fused Artifacts
mod.description: This modification transforms the existing combination artifacts from Shadow of Death and Horn of the Abyss into fused artifacts. Unlike traditional combination artifacts, which occupy multiple slots when assembled, a fused artifact takes up only a single slot. However, keep in mind that they cannot be disassembled!
